headline: Germany signs its industrial AI pact with Nvidia, Anthropic is reportedly lining up $45bn of compute with Nscale, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 drops on Netflix today, and UFC 333 and Austin loom at the weekend.

upcoming.what: Orionid meteor shower peaks overnight; best after midnight, moonlight permitting
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launches on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2 and PC
UFC 333, Abu Dhabi: Volkanovski vs Evloev, Yan vs Dvalishvili 3. Early prelims 15:00, prelims 17:00, main card 19:00 Irish time
F1 United States GP, Austin. Qualifying Sat 22:00, race Sun 20:00 Irish time (clocks go back that morning). Antonelli can clinch the title
Ocarina of Time remake launches on Switch 2
IBJJF The Crown, Long Beach: invitation-only, eight-athlete brackets across six divisions

items.headline: Germany signs its industrial AI deal with Nvidia
items.summary: Announced at a Berlin investment summit on Monday, the pact aims to build industrial AI models trained on German data and manufacturing know-how. It's the deal flagged last week, now official.

items.headline: Nscale reportedly in talks on a ~$45bn compute deal with Anthropic
items.summary: Per Bloomberg, the capacity would come from a second facility at Nscale's Monarch campus in West Virginia. Nothing is signed yet.

items.headline: SpaceX retries its Bandwagon-5 rideshare this morning
items.summary: After Monday's weather scrub, the launch from Cape Canaveral is targeted for 11:30 Irish time today. It carries 31 customer payloads plus another flight of SpaceX's Starfall reentry capsule, a small orbital lab that brings experiments back to Earth.

items.headline: Alaska landslide tsunami ran 1,580 feet up a mountainside
items.summary: Researchers have reconstructed a landslide-triggered wave that ranks as the second-highest tsunami ever recorded.

items.headline: Astronomers find the first white dwarf that looks green
items.summary: A survey turned up white dwarfs glowing in unexpected colours, including one that appears green, a first for any known star.

items.headline: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 lands on Netflix today
items.summary: Ten episodes, a standalone story with a new crew in Night City. Hideo Kojima reportedly turns up in a cameo. No news today on Cyberpunk 2 or The Witcher 4 themselves.

items.headline: Big release week: Modern Warfare 4 arrives Friday
items.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 headlines the week on Friday. Earlier in the week there's Final Fantasy Resonance, the console edition of Peak, and Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves on Switch 2.

items.headline: Still quiet on the mats; Tsarukyan vs Neiman Gracie on the horizon
items.summary: No major pro grappling results this week. The next notable dates are The Crown on 8 November and Arman Tsarukyan against Neiman Gracie at Real American Freestyle in Abu Dhabi on 14 November.

items.headline: UFC 333 card locked in for Saturday
items.summary: The main card is Volkanovski vs Evloev, Yan vs Dvalishvili 3, England's Lone'er Kavanagh vs Ramazan Temirov, Volkov vs Kuniev, and Pico vs Keita. It's an early start: main card at 19:00 Irish time.

items.headline: Ian Machado Garry expected back before year's end
items.summary: A report says the Irish welterweight's next fight is set to be announced soon for later in 2026. No opponent is confirmed yet.

items.headline: Austin storylines: Mercedes upgrade, Verstappen's surge, Hamilton–Ferrari friction
items.summary: Mercedes' upgrade package faces its real test after a poor Malaysia showing. Verstappen arrives on two straight wins and sits 8 points behind Hamilton, who is under scrutiny after ignoring a pit call in Singapore.

items.headline: McLaren's slump puts Norris under the spotlight
items.summary: After summer wins in Hungary and the Netherlands, Norris's best in the last triple-header was fourth, and his clash with Piastri in a sprint cost both drivers points.
